author: New China TV
description:
#Indonesia was hit by two powerful earthquakes within about 12 hours on Saturday, with the first killing at least 38 people on the eastern island of #Flores.
The magnitude-7.7 quake struck off Flores, leaving people trapped in buildings and triggering landslides that blocked roads in some of the hardest-hit areas.
About 12 hours later, a separate magnitude-6.8 earthquake struck thousands of kilometers away near #Sumatra in western Indonesia.
title: Indonesia hit by back-to-back powerful earthquakes

author: New China TV
description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping has always been deeply concerned about the remote mountainous and forested regions, as well as the people who live there.
He called for adherence to the path of green development that puts ecology first and efforts to build a beautiful China with green mountains, lucid waters and fresh air.
Thanks to the dedicated efforts of three generations of workers, Saihanba, once a piece of barren wilderness, has become the world's largest artificial plantation. Meanwhile, the forest coverage rate of Ma'anshan Forest Farm has risen from less than 20 percent initially to 95.7 percent.
#LeadingChina
title: Green echoes in two forest farms

author: New China TV
description:
A Shared Memory, A Lasting Bond
Soviet pilot Alexander Orekhov gave his life fighting for China against Japanese aggression in 1938.
For years, his grandnephew Alexey searched for his story -- until a memorial worker in Nanjing, Miao Lei, helped bring it to light.
"You gave your life to help us. I will spend my life remembering you," said Miao.
#WWII #peace
title: A Shared Memory, A Lasting Bond

description:
"Denying the painful #history of the past does not make what happened disappear," said Kim Joo-Yong, professor in the Department of History and Culture, Wonkwang University, lambasting #Japan's "historical denialists" for whitewashing its wartime atrocities like the 1937 #NanjingMassacre and the 1919 suppression of the March 1 Independence Movement on the Korean Peninsula.
Tokyo's failure to break free from its imperialist past threatens regional stability and saddles future generations with a heavy cost, he said.
#militarism #WWII

author: New China TV
description:
The Yellow River, known as the mother river of the Chinese nation, stretches over 5,000 km across nine provincial regions.
Chinese President Xi Jinping attaches great importance to the river's ecological protection.
At the river's two ends -- its source in Qinghai and its estuary in Shandong -- concerted efforts are being made to safeguard ecosystems and chart a greener path for development.
title: Eco-conservation at both ends of the Yellow River
